Name: Ragdoll cat bundle
Author: peroxidewren
Description:
[font=Times New Roman]Hey guys!

So here's my mod for a Ragdoll cat pet replacement (based on my own cat Sherlock). I haven't tested all of these so let me know if anything is amiss at all (e.g. stray pixels).

[b]Update: [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/kuriiyo.716324/]Kuriiyo[/url] and [/b][url=http://https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/53665211-dabblydabs/]DabblyDabs[/url][b] [/b]kindly converted the .xnb files into a Content Patcher pack, and it is now available to download here.
[b]Update 2:[/b] I've uploaded the colourpoint variation, tweaked the bi-colour sprites as they looked a little off to me, and removed the old sprites from the content pack.

[/font][center]﻿[font=Times New Roman][b]Bicolour [/b](Seal, Blue, Lilac, Cream, & Flame)

[img]https://community.playstarbound.com/attachments/bicolour-sheet-gif-gif.202326/[/img]

[b]Mitted [/b](Seal, Blue, Lilac, Cream, & Flame)
[img]http://community.playstarbound.com/attachments/all-mittedsitslicks-gif.177200/[/img]
[img]http://community.playstarbound.com/attachments/all-mittedcats-sheet-gif.177199/[/img]

[b]Colourpoint[/b] (Seal, Blue, Lilac, Cream, & Flame)
[/font][img]https://community.playstarbound.com/attachments/colourpointsitslicks-gif.202328/[/img][font=Times New Roman]
[/font][img]https://community.playstarbound.com/attachments/colourpoint-sheet-gif-gif.202327/[/img][/center]
[center][/center][font=Times New Roman][b]To install:[/b]
[b]-[/b]Install the latest version of[b] [/b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][b].[/b]
[b]-[/b]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][b].[/b]
[b]-[/b]Unzip this Ragdoll pet replacement pack into Stardew Valley\Mods to install it.
[b]-[/b]Run the game using SMAPI.

-To change your cat variation, edit your config.json file to include the name of the sprite sheet you want to use from the 'assets' folder.
Instructions on how to do this are included in this download as a README.


If anyone wants to add this mod to a compilation, please feel free to (I would absolutely love to hear if anyone does[img]http://community.playstarbound.com/custom_emotes/catface.png[/img])[/font]

Downloads.Description: Ragdoll cat replacements (Content Patcher pack) available in Bi-colour, Mitted, and Colourpoint variations (all three come in the colours: Seal, Blue, Lilac, Flame, and Cream).
